episodes.title: Understand SCADA, You Must
episodes.subtitle: EPICS & TANGO Revealed
episodes.synopsis: What is a SCADA system? Through the lens of Star Wars, we explore the three core layers of any industrial control system: hardware, communication bus, and business logic. No prior knowledge required. Just Droids, holograms, and the Emperor.

episodes.title: Same Death Star, Different Blueprints
episodes.subtitle: TANGO vs EPICS
episodes.synopsis: Same three layers. Two very different galaxies. EPICS and TANGO solve almost the same problems — but speak different languages. PV vs Attribute. Channel Access vs CORBA. IOC vs Device Server. We decode both, side by side.

episodes.title: TANGO & EPICS — The Persuaders
episodes.subtitle: Origins & Human Stories
episodes.synopsis: Every great system has an origin story. Where did TANGO come from? Who built EPICS, and why? Two frameworks, two histories, two teams who decided to solve the same problem — in their own way.

episodes.title: How SCADA Talks to the Real World
episodes.subtitle: Hardware & Field Communication
episodes.synopsis: PLCs, OPC-UA, Modbus, Siemens S7 — the physical layer demystified. How does a software system actually talk to motors, valves, and sensors in the real world?

seasons.title: Season 2
seasons.subtitle: Inside the Machine
seasons.tagline: Going deeper. Still no jargon without explanation.

episodes.title: AI & SCADA — A New Hope
episodes.subtitle: When the Force meets the Machine
episodes.synopsis: What happens when AI meets industrial control systems? From anomaly detection to alarm postmortem analysis, from documentation generation to decision-support tools — the future of SCADA is already here.
